internal_note: Confirmed strategy: upon receipt cost reveal, claim exactly own cost (2-8). Approve A's claim only if it matches A's verified receipt cost to avoid overpaying. Initial approval set conservatively (e.g., 0) if A's cost unknown, updated when known. Monitor A's claim for compliance with cost to prevent negative payoff. This ensures reimbursement equals receipt cost per organization rule and maximizes personal payoff by avoiding overpayments or underclaims.
